user.title: Connect to the Puzzlebox app
user.description: No running Puzzlebox app was found automatically. Enter its address and bridge token; both are shown on the Settings page inside Puzzlebox.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the app.

abort.already_configured: Already connected to the Puzzlebox app.

run_program.name: Run program
run_program.description: Runs a Puzzlebox program now. Choose the program's switch or run button, or give its name.

program.name: Program
program.description: Program name or id (instead of choosing its entity).

variables.name: Variables
variables.description: Data available to the program as trigger variables.

set_variable.name: Set stored variable
set_variable.description: Sets a stored variable that programs can read.

program.name: Program
program.description: Program name or id. Leave empty for a global variable.

update_app.title: Update the Puzzlebox app
update_app.description: The Puzzlebox app ({app_version}) is older than the integration ({integration_version}). Everything keeps working, but some features are unavailable until you update the app under **Settings → Apps → Puzzlebox**.

update_app_required.title: The Puzzlebox app needs an update
update_app_required.description: The Puzzlebox app ({app_version}) is too old for this integration ({integration_version}), so programs don't appear in Home Assistant. Update the app under **Settings → Apps → Puzzlebox**.

update_integration.title: Update the Puzzlebox integration
update_integration.description: The Puzzlebox integration ({integration_version}) is older than the app ({app_version}). Everything keeps working, but some features are unavailable until you update the integration in HACS and restart Home Assistant.

update_integration_required.title: The Puzzlebox integration needs an update
update_integration_required.description: The Puzzlebox integration ({integration_version}) is too old for this app ({app_version}), so programs don't appear in Home Assistant. Update the integration in HACS and restart Home Assistant.

program_invalid.title: Puzzlebox program “{name}” can't run as built
program_invalid.description:
Part or all of the program **{name}** can't run: {problems}

This often happens when an entity it uses was renamed or removed. Open the program in Puzzlebox, fix the blocks marked with a warning and save. This message goes away by itself once the program is fixed or turned off.

program_failing.title: Puzzlebox program “{name}” keeps failing
program_failing.description:
The last {count} runs of **{name}** failed. The latest error was: {error}

Open the program in Puzzlebox and look at its runs to see where it stops. This message goes away by itself after a run succeeds or when the program is turned off.
